title: Birbal and the Hidden Treasure
moral: The truth often reveals itself through small details.

scenes.summary: A man reports his buried treasure missing.
scenes.text: One day, a man came to Emperor Akbar and said his buried treasure was missing.
scenes.image_prompt: man explaining lost treasure to king in court, cartoon style

scenes.text: Birbal asked questions about where the treasure was buried and who might have seen it.

scenes.summary: The man mentions his neighbor might have seen him.
scenes.text: The man remembered that his neighbor might have seen him bury the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: man thinking while talking to birbal, cartoon illustration

scenes.text: Birbal asked the neighbor about the tree, and he answered quickly, revealing his knowledge.

scenes.summary: The neighbor confesses and the truth is revealed.
scenes.text: Birbal realized the neighbor was the thief. He confessed, and Akbar praised Birbal. The truth often reveals itself through small details.

story: One day, a man told Emperor Akbar that his buried treasure was missing. Birbal asked questions and learned that a neighbor might have seen him. When the neighbor answered a question about the tree too quickly, Birbal realized he knew about the treasure. The neighbor confessed, and Akbar praised Birbal.
